notes.title: Patch Notes v0.02
notes.content:
A new section of the game - Practice. Ride on all cars on the test polygon well, without rules and conditions.
Cooperative play in split-screen. In test mode, added a scene from the game to play together. 

- Fixed Start scene.
- Added saving progress passed levels.

Thanks for your help, as always!) 
We read all your wishes and in the next update correct.
